findings.message: Spreading every cell into Math.max throws RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded once the matrix has roughly 100k entries, so format() dies on exactly the large matrices where a formatted dump is most useful. Fold instead of spreading.
findings.suggestion: const width = cells.flat().reduce((widest, cell) => Math.max(widest, cell.length), 0)

findings.message: Any input that ends in a non-alphanumeric character yields a trailing separator, so slug('Hello World!') returns 'hello-world-'. Used in a URL or an id that trailing hyphen makes two inputs that should collide produce different keys.

columns() reports the width of row 0, which is only the matrix's column count once rectangularity has been checked. transpose and multiply rely on that ordering; a reader adding a new operation will not see it. Say so in a one-line comment above the function.
